newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank top contender for Filipino bank.
newsitem.headline: Maybank top contender for Filipino bank.

text.p: Malaysia's Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) is a top contender for the acquisition of a large stake in PNB-Republic Bank, Peter B. Favila, president of the Philippine National Bank, said on Monday.
"The preliminary reaction from the monetary authority in Philippines shows that Maybank is a very strong contender," Favila told reporters at a news conference to launch an Asian banking conference.
He said that one of the monetary authority's considerations was that Maybank, Malaysia's biggest commercial bank, was a very strong bank.
PNB-Republic Bank is a 58.8 percent-owned commercial banking subsidiary of the Philippines National Bank.
Favila told reporters that 14 banks had lodged letters of intent with the Philippines National Bank.
At the conference, Amirsham Aziz, managing director of Maybank, declined to give either the value of the bid or the amount of equity it plans to acquire in PNB-RB.
Favila said the results of the bidding would be known by the end of 1996.
"We have made representation to the central bank for the decision to be made by the end of the year," Favila said.
